service.name: Corporate holiday party entertainment
service.serviceType: Live bands and DJs for corporate holiday parties
service.description: Live music and DJs for corporate holiday parties in Denver and along the Front Range, November and December 2026, with open dates and every rate published.

faqs.q: What December dates are still open for a holiday party band?
faqs.a: The season board on this page is the answer, kept current: 21 published party dates across November and December 2026, 10 of them in December, covering Thursdays, Fridays and Saturdays plus New Year's Eve. It was verified against the live booking calendar in August, and a date that reads open is genuinely open.

faqs.q: When do companies book holiday party entertainment?
faqs.a: August through October is when the season is decided for November and December dates. Established acts book out by Thanksgiving, and New Year's Eve books first of all. Past October you are choosing from cancellations rather than the calendar.

faqs.q: What does a holiday party band cost?
faqs.a: Every rate is published before you write: duo, trio, quartet and DJ each price as a range on the rate card, with sound included at every size. Holiday and peak weekends carry +25% and New Year's Eve +50%, published rather than discovered at contract. Travel beyond the Denver metro is its own line.

faqs.q: Can one booking cover dinner and dancing?
faqs.a: Yes, and it is the most common booking of the season: a duo through drinks and dinner, then a DJ carrying the back half, on one contract. Once we are in the building the call-out is already paid, so the added hours bill at the hourly rate only.

faqs.q: Can our procurement process clear a booking in time?
faqs.a: Yes, if it starts in October rather than December. We can be set up as a vendor, quote against a purchase order and take net-30 on approval, with a certificate of insurance naming your venue, a W-9 and one itemised invoice in the same email as the contract. Vendor onboarding is the slowest step of a corporate booking.
